info.title: Starboard API
info.description: Make a key in Starboard: Settings, Security, API keys. Send it as Authorization: Bearer sb_read_... or sb_manage_... A read key reads; a manage key also does the everyday actions (each POST, marked x-right: manage). x-scope is the scope a key needs. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details. Lists use limit and cursor. Answers carry an ETag; send If-None-Match to get 304.

get.summary: Events as they happen, as Server-Sent Events
get.description: A text/event-stream. Each event is CloudEvents-shaped JSON: specversion, id, type (such as starboard.app.down), source, time and data. A key hears only the events its scopes cover. Send Last-Event-ID to resume. Up to 8 streams at once; each closes after an hour.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: The id of the last event you read.

target.description: starboard, reelix, app:<app id> or plugin:<plug-in id>, as /api/v1/updates lists them.

202.description: Started. Read status, the run's address, every few seconds until its state is not running.

post.description: Only for keys that ticked Updates: a key with no scopes does not have them. One update runs at a time. Each has the same backup, health check and way back as on the pages: Starboard runs update.sh; Reelix and the other apps keep their old image until the new one is healthy; a plug-in runs its before step, moves its settings, waits for its health check and goes back by itself if it fails. Never from an address: only the version Starboard already found.

post.summary: Roll a plug-in back to the version kept before its last update

target.description: starboard, reelix, app:<app id> or plugin:<plug-in id>, as /api/v1/updates lists them.

202.description: Started. Read status until its state is rolled-back.

post.description: Only for keys that ticked Updates: a key with no scopes does not have them. Only plug-ins keep the version before. Starboard and the apps go back by themselves when a new version does not answer, so for them this answers 409 cannot_update.

get.summary: Every download that needs attention or failed, with its details, and as Markdown for an AI helper
get.description: Each app's queue is asked once when you call this (at most every 10 seconds), never on a timer. markdown starts with a short prompt telling an AI helper what to do, then one section for each download. Keys, passwords, tokens, private addresses and full download addresses are taken out; paths are only those in media and download folders.

key.description: A Starboard API key, sb_read_... or sb_manage_...

cursor.name: cursor
cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous answer.

idempotency.name: Idempotency-Key
idempotency.description: Send the same value again to get the first answer back without doing it twice. Kept for 24 hours.

X-Request-Id.description: Yours, or one Starboard made; also in problem.instance.

reelix.description: true when the download is Reelix's.

kind.description: film, episode, album, book or radio episode, when known.

what.description: The film, episode or book it is for, when the app says.

app_state.description: The app's own state words, such as tracked_state importBlocked.

messages.description: Every message from the app, with secrets and private addresses taken out.

download_client_ids.description: download_id (the torrent's id or the Usenet download's id) and, for Reelix, client_id_in_reelix.

paths.description: output: where it downloaded to, as the app sees it inside its container. Only media and download folders.

ids.description: The ids in the app (in Reelix, Reelix's ids): queue, and film, series, episode, album, book or radio show.

tried.description: What Starboard already did about it, oldest first.
